#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int N = 1000009;
const int MOD = 1e9+7;

long long modExp(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1, cur_base = base;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = result * cur_base % mod;
        cur_base = cur_base * cur_base % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int visited[N];

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
    freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
#endif

    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    int answer = 1;
    if (k == 0) {
        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i)
            answer = (long long)answer * p % MOD;
        cout << answer << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        if (visited[i]) continue;
        int j = i, d = 0;
        do {
            visited[j] = ++d;
            j = (long long)j * k % p;
        } while (!visited[j]);
        if (modExp(k, d, p) == 1)
            answer = (long long)answer * p % MOD;
    }
    cout << answer << endl;
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    fclose(stdin); fclose(stdout);
#endif
    return 0;
}
